newsitem.title: JAPAN: ATHLETICS-SOUTH KOREA'S LEE WINS FUKUOKA MARATHON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-SOUTH KOREA'S LEE WINS FUKUOKA MARATHON.

text.p: South Korea's Lee Bong-ju won the Fukuoka international marathon on Sunday in two hours, 10 minutes and 48 seconds, shaking off a challenge from Spain's Alberto Juzdado.
The 26-year-old Lee ran neck-and-neck with Juzdado until the last 100 metres after the pair had earlier shaken off the pack of four rivals who stayed with them for the first 40 km.
Juzdado finished two seconds behind Lee under snowy and windy conditions.
"I couldn't predict what would happen because of the bad weather and cold temperatures," Atlanta Olympic silver medalist Lee said after winning the race.
"I was determined to win this race by beating (Josiah) Thugwane to whom I lost in Atlanta," he said.
Thugwane of South Africa walked out of Sunday's race after running 28.6 km.
Defending champion Luiz Antonio dos Santos of Brazil finished third in two hours 11 minutes 24 seconds.
